Description: Country: Mexico ES EL MOMENTO Santander (www.santander.com) está evolucionando de ser una marca global de alto impacto a una organización impulsada por la tecnología, y las personas están en el centro de este camino. Juntos, estamos liderando una transformación centrada en el cliente que valora el pensamiento disruptivo, la valentía de desafiar lo posible y la capacidad de innovar. Esto es más que un cambio estratégico: es una oportunidad para crecer, aprender y generar un impacto real. Nuestra misión es contribuir a que más personas y empresas prosperen. Adoptamos una sólida cultura de riesgos y esperamos que todos nuestros equipos asuman un enfoque proactivo y responsable en la gestión del riesgo. Somos Banco Santander México, institución financiera líder que, a través de más de 160 años de reinvención, ha llegado a ser una organización sin fronteras con presencia en más de 40 países, 95 nacionalidades y equipos multiculturales que comparten 4 idiomas. EL IMPACTO QUE GENERARÁS Estamos buscando un/a GTE. ESTRATEGIAS DECISION CRED AUTO con base en Corporativo Santa Fe, CDMX. Estamos redefiniendo nuestra forma de trabajar a través de la innovación, la tecnología de última generación, la colaboración y la libertad de explorar nuevas ideas. En este puesto, tus principales responsabilidades incluirán: Aplicar técnicas de Inteligencia Artificial, Machine Learning y analítica avanzada para desarrollar modelos predictivos que fortalezcan las estrategias de admisión, cobranza, campañas de clientes preaprobados, estimación de parámetros de riesgo, propensión y comportamiento del cliente, promoviendo una toma de decisiones basada en datos (Data-Driven Decision Making). Diseñar, implementar y optimizar las estrategias de decisión para las etapas de originación y administración del portafolio de Crédito Automotriz, asegurando su correcta ejecución, monitoreo continuo y alineación con los objetivos de riesgo, rentabilidad y crecimiento del negocio. Desarrollar modelos de monitoreo automatizados (dashboards e indicadores) que permitan evaluar el desempeño del portafolio en tiempo real, identificando desviaciones, oportunidades de mejora y generando información estratégica para la toma de decisiones de la Dirección mediante analítica avanzada. Liderar, en conjunto con el área de Metodología, el diseño, desarrollo, calibración y seguimiento de modelos analíticos de Credit Scoring, estrategias de decisión, Risk-Based Pricing y modelos predictivos, incorporando técnicas de Inteligencia Artificial y Machine Learning para optimizar la administración del riesgo y maximizar la rentabilidad del portafolio. Diseñar y evolucionar las estrategias de decisión asociadas a nuevos modelos de riesgo, garantizando el cumplimiento de los indicadores clave de desempeño (KPIs), así como una adecuada implementación en los procesos de originación y gestión del crédito. Definir y proponer mejoras a las políticas de Crédito Automotriz, sustentadas en el análisis del comportamiento del portafolio, tendencias del mercado, indicadores de riesgo y modelos analíticos, con el objetivo de optimizar los niveles de aprobación, formalización, morosidad y rentabilidad. Coordinar la definición y seguimiento de la Planeación Estratégica Comercial (PEC), facilitando la alineación de prioridades, iniciativas y objetivos con las estrategias del negocio y del Banco. LO QUE APORTARÁS AL EQUIPO Nuestra gente es nuestra mayor fortaleza. Cada persona contribuye con perspectivas únicas que nos hacen más fuertes como equipo y como organización. Valoramos quiénes son y potenciamos lo que aportan. Los siguientes requisitos representan los conocimientos, habilidades y competencias esenciales para este puesto. Toma un momento para entender a lo que nos referimos: Contratación directa con Banco Santander. Esquema de contratación permanente. Prestaciones de Ley y superiores. Beneficios exclusivos de Banco Santander Estamos aquí para mantener tu motivación, ayudarte a alcanzar tus metas y celebrar tus logros en cada paso del camino. CUMPLIMIENTO LOCAL Santander se enorgullece de ser una organización que ofrece igualdad de oportunidades sin importar edad, género, discapacidad, estado civil, raza, religión u orientación sexual. Estamos comprometidos en ofrecer un proceso de selección inclusivo y accesible para todas las personas. ¿Y AHORA QUÉ? Title: Sustainability Data Analyst / Project Manager
Description: About Earthworm Earthworm is a group of people who believes we can solve the big issues affecting people and nature today. We work in global supply chains impacting millions of people and places around the world to make the products we buy. We work on the ground, in forests, fields and factories, helping companies, farmers and communities find practical solutions together. And we know that, ultimately, trust and positive changes comes from people getting to work together, hands in the soil. Your Role We currently have 2 positions being vacant in LATAM, here the descriptions below: Role #1 : As a Sustainability Data Analyst in the Analytics team, you would be managing large, complex data sets, ensuring their integrity and quality, while creating clear and compelling reports to support data-driven decision-making for our clients. Your main responsibilities will include: Collect, clean and analyse information you receive from our clients to explain major trends and support the elaboration of recommendations guiding companies to transform their supply chains. Summarise data insights in the shape of reports to provide a compelling story on the impact of deforestation on our customers’ supply chains, related to various agricultural commodities (e.g. palm oil, soy, cocoa). Collaborate with your colleagues in Malaysia, Indonesia, Ecuador, Ghana and Switzerland to complete the reports, and provide further data analysis as needed. Provide guidance and mentoring to other analysts in report delivery, insight generation and stakeholder engagement. Demonstrate leadership in ensuring that our output is of high quality and delivered on time. Stay on the lookout for ways to improve our internal processes and how we work together. Role #2 : As a Sustainability Data Project Manager in the Solution Architects team, you would be a critical bridge between the Global Data Team, field teams, subject matter experts, and partnership managers – enabling transparency and sustainability in our clients’ supply chains through data solution design, improvement and management. Your main responsibilities will include: Gathering data needs from internal teams and translating them into clear technical requirements. Leading data projects and managing relationships with external partners, including database implementations and process reviews. Managing and integrating existing database systems and workflows. Designing, implementing, and improving data processes end-to-end: from structure and collection to transformation, storage (ETL), analysis, and visualisation. Building robust, scalable data solutions for new commodities, products, and services. Contributing to BI dashboard development, data analysis, and the exploration of new tools and technologies (e.g. workflow automation, AI) to strengthen EF’s data capabilities. Please indicate in your application which position you are most interested about. Your Profile You're driven by a desire to create positive impact for people and the planet, and you see technology and data as powerful levers to get there. You also have a passion for local and regional development. You thrive in collaborative environments, working closely with or managing diverse and multicultural teams, but can also work independently and take ownership of projects. Your strong communication skills and diplomatic approach will help you build strong relationships and navigate difficult conversations with ease. You are not afraid to speak up and ask questions, and you welcome being challenged, if it improves your understanding and makes the work better. You take initiative and if you've committed to something, it gets done thoughtfully and thoroughly because you take pride in your work and feel responsible towards the people and places your data ultimately serves. Precision and integrity matter to you, as you have a strong attention to detail and you'd rather flag a flaw than let it slide, and you hold yourself to the same standard you expect of others. You’re a curious problem-solver who asks "why" before "how". Complex systems and dynamic situations draw you in rather than intimidate you, and you're comfortable moving between technical depth and the bigger picture. You also bring a creative streak to problem-solving, as you're drawn to elegant, well-crafted and reliable solutions with your own thoughtful or innovative stamp on them. Desirable skills for the roles: Advanced Excel skills (including VBA) Experience with Python or other programming languages Experience with Tableau or other BI software PowerPoint skills Excellent project management skills Experience in database management and/or data engineering (e.g. PostgreSQL databases or similar, ArcGIS Enterprise, ArcGIS Online) Workings Conditions • Education : Bachelor’s Degree in a relevant field (preferable) • Experience : Minimum 2 years, ideally in agriculture, social science, rural development, forestry and conservation, or similar fields of work • Language(s) : English & Spanish (C1 English & B2/C1 Spanish at minimum) • Employment : Full-time, 1-year contract • Location : Quito, Ecuador OR Ciudad de Mexico, Mexico • Start Date: ASAP • Other: Citizenship or valid work permit Joining Us If you are in search of having a meaningful impact, with a desire to innovate and act for the environment, this offer is for you! The team you would join is truly committed to and passionate about finding concrete solutions to improve relationship between People and Nature. Only selected candidates will be contacted.

Description: Jeeves is a groundbreaking financial operating system built for global businesses that provides corporate cards, cross-border payments, and spend management software within one unified platform. The company operates across 20+ countries including Brazil, Canada, Colombia, Mexico, the United Kingdom, across Europe, and the United States, and serves over 5,000 clients ranging from venture-backed startups to SMBs around the world. With a mission to empower businesses with more efficient and cost-effective financial solutions worldwide, Jeeves combines cutting-edge financial technology with exceptional team expertise to transform the business financial landscape. Jeeves has been recognized as one of The Information's 50 Most Promising Startups in 2023, as well as a Y Combinator Top Company 2021-2023 and won “Fintech of the Year" at the European Fintech Awards. Since graduating from Y Combinator in 2020, Jeeves has successfully raised over $380 million and is backed by top world-class investors including Andreessen Horowitz, Y Combinator, CRV, Tencent, Stanford University, Clocktower Ventures, and founders of more than 15 unicorns including David Velez (Nubank), Carlos Garcia (Kavak) and Sebastián Mejía (Rappi). This role is focused on Jeeves’s growth programs and emerging revenue channels — including our partnerships channel and new market expansion initiatives — where we need rigorous, scalable analytics to match the pace of growth. You’ll be responsible for the analytical layer that connects our sales activity to revenue outcomes: building the dashboards our leadership relies on, maintaining shared responsibility for the integrity of our performance data, and proactively surfacing the insights that shape how we operate. You’ll work closely with the Head of Revenue Operations and contribute meaningfully to planning and review cycles alongside GTM leadership. The pace here is real. Priorities shift, timelines compress, and the ground moves under your feet — not occasionally, but constantly. We need someone who is energized by that, not worn down. You won’t wait for someone to tell you what to look at. You’ll already know. Key Responsibilities GTM Analytics & Growth Program Insights Build and maintain Tableau dashboards tracking performance across our partnerships channel and new growth initiatives — serving audiences from country leads to executive leadership. Analyze conversion rates, pipeline health, ramp trends, and revenue attainment across programs and segments, surfacing patterns before they become decisions that have already been made. Come with a point of view. When a program is underperforming or a trend shifts, bring an interpretation and a recommendation (not just a chart). Support quarterly and annual GTM business reviews with structured analysis: cohort breakdowns, market-level benchmarks, and forward-looking indicators. Revenue Planning & Target Analysis Contribute to GTM capacity planning and quota-setting cycles — modeling scenarios, building attainment reports, and stress-testing assumptions before plans are finalized. Maintain performance-against-target reporting for growth programs and emerging channels: track attainment, flag outliers early, and ensure data is always reconciled. Support variable compensation analysis for relevant programs — running calculations, auditing for accuracy, and partnering with Finance to ensure payouts are correct and timely. Build and maintain data structures that support reliable rolling forecasts for new and high-growth segments. AI-Driven Operations & Scale Use AI tools, including Claude and other frontier models, as active parts of your workflow: automating repetitive reporting tasks, accelerating data synthesis, and building scalable analytical programs that would otherwise require a much larger team. Identify RevOps processes that can be operationalized or significantly improved through AI, and take ownership of building those solutions, not just flagging the opportunity. Apply AI-assisted analysis to extract insights at scale from large, multi-source datasets: pipeline signals, rep activity, customer behavior, and market trends. Help establish Jeeves’s AI-first approach to RevOps as a model for how the broader GTM team operates. Data Quality & Systems Integration Share responsibility for data quality across our revenue stack (HubSpot CRM, Tableau, and financial systems), conducting audits for accuracy, completeness, and consistency. Connect disparate data sources (CRM, marketing automation, financial tools, and proprietary revenue data) so that reporting on growth programs is unified and trustworthy. Document data models, metric definitions, and reporting logic so the team works from a shared understanding of what we’re measuring and why. Stakeholder Partnership Develop enough context on our GTM motion to contribute meaningfully in planning and pipeline review cycles alongside sales leadership, bringing data that drives decisions, not just awareness. Serve as a reliable analytical resource to the Head of Revenue Operations and GTM leadership: scope requests clearly, pull the data, and return clear answers quickly. Identify process gaps and proactively propose improvements to how we collect, manage, and act on GTM data (especially across new and growing channels). What We’re Looking For Technical & Analytical Skills Tableau mastery: able to write complex calculated fields, build multi-source dashboards, and design views for diverse audiences from reps to the C-suite. Advanced Excel and Google Sheets: complex formulas, pivot tables, and financial modeling — you reach for the right tool for the job, not just the most impressive one. Strong SQL skills: you can get to an answer independently without waiting for a data engineer to pull it for you. Data integration experience: comfortable connecting CRM, marketing automation, and financial data into unified reporting environments. Business metrics fluency: deep understanding of conversion rates, customer lifetime value (LTV), pipeline coverage, ramp curves, revenue attainment, and customer health. Data modeling: able to design clean structures that support accurate forecasting, compensation analysis, and multi-region rollups. AI Fluency (Required, Not Optional) You actively use AI tools, Claude Copilot/Code, or equivalent, as part of your day-to-day workflow, not as a novelty. You’ve used AI to automate reporting pipelines, accelerate analysis, or build operational programs that scale beyond what a single analyst could do manually. You’re curious about where AI can go next in RevOps and you bring ideas, not just execution. Soft Skills & Ways of Working Hungry and driven: you want to build something generational, and you bring the energy and output to match. You hold yourself to a higher standard than anyone else will hold you to. Thrives in high-velocity environments: you’re not just comfortable with ambiguity and shifting priorities — you’re energized by them. You find a way through, not a reason to wait. High agency: you don’t wait for a ticket. You’re already thinking about what the data might be missing or what question leadership will ask next week. Sharp communicator: your outputs — whether a Slack message, a Tableau dashboard, or a business review slide — are concise, structured, and ready for a senior audience. Strong time management: you’re comfortable managing multiple live workstreams, setting expectations on timelines, and delivering reliably under pressure. Low ego and collaborative: Jeeves is building something ambitious across complex markets. You’re here to make the whole team better, not just your function. Qualifications 2–4 years in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Business Analytics, or a related GTM-adjacent role. Hands-on Tableau experience is required. You should be able to demonstrate dashboards you’ve built from scratch. Advanced proficiency in Excel and/or Google Sheets. Experience working with CRM data (HubSpot preferred) and connecting it to downstream reporting. Exposure to incentive compensation modeling, quota attainment reporting, or variable pay analysis is strongly preferred. Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Data Science, or a related field. Fluency in English is required; proficiency in Spanish and/or Portuguese is preferred. Nice to Have Experience in B2B fintech, payments, corporate banking, or expense management. Familiarity with multi-currency, multi-region revenue reporting. Experience building or improving compensation and quota-tracking systems end-to-end. Background in channel partnerships, broker networks, or indirect sales models. What We Offer Competitive salary and performance-based bonus. The chance to work on analytically complex problems across 3+ continents and multiple currencies — at a company moving fast enough that your work actually changes things. A lean team that uses AI first, moves with urgency, and trusts you to own your domain from day one. Direct exposure to senior RevOps and GTM leadership. A culture that values output, curiosity, and honest feedback over hierarchy — and that genuinely believes it’s building something that matters. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

This position uses data analytics to advise strategic direction on the deployment of new and existing data-driven solutions via reports, presentations, and interactive dashboards. This person will be a trusted partner to leaders from cross-functional teams and must be able to understand the strategic objectives in each business area. Perform quality assurance and ongoing monitoring of current reports and data for accuracy and usage. Evaluate, analyze, and recommend the potential for opportunities that enhance business direction and competitive positioning. Develop clear and concise written interpretations for the communication of results to various user groups. Work with cross functional teams to ensure integrated Circana insights and messaging to organization Train new hires on Insights Team data capabilities as well as existing reporting Supports new item tracking, competitive landscape analysis and identification of trends from syndicated data sources Perform ad hoc analysis as needed to support insights projects Developing skills necessary to present analytic findings at an Executive Summary level. QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE 2-3 years of experience in Analytics or Large Set Data Analysis Syndicated Data experience with Circana, Nielsen, or other relevant platforms a plus Experience managing multiple projects at once and able to prioritize/adapt quickly EDUCATION & SKILLS Bachelor’s degree in Business/Data Analytics, Mathematics, Statistics or other related field; Master’s degree a plus Ability to analyze and synthesize large amounts of data to problem solve across the organization Results-focused strategic thinker who translates data into actionable insights and recommendations Able to engage in consultative manner with cross functional partners to provide analysis support or deliverables Detail oriented and highly organized Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills Good attitude and desire to constantly learn and expand your skills COMPUTER/TECHNICAL SKILLS Proficient with PowerBI, Tableau or other comparable BI tools Familiar with statistical analysis with software, e.g. R or Python Familiar with database tools and concepts, such as MS SQL Server Highly proficient in MS Office suite, including Excel, Access, Word, PowerPoint and Visio PHYSICAL DEMANDS While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit; have flexible use of hands; and talk or hear. The employee is occasionally required to stand, walk, and reach with hands and arms. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, and color vision. WORK ENVIRONMENT General office environment. Some travel is required.

Description: **18 months contract** Overview / Purpose The SAP Data Lead provides direction and expertise for the design and implementation of data deliverables across a complex SAP data migration programme. The role leads the design and delivery of an end‑to‑end ETLR process and strategy, oversees execution of data migration cycles, mentors data stewards and acts as the primary escalation point for data migration issues, risks and audit queries. Strong hands‑on SAP experience and the ability to troubleshoot data migration failures are essential. Key Responsibilities Lead the design and implementation of an end‑to‑end ETLR (Extract, Transform, Load, Reconcile) process, approach and strategy for multiple data migration cycles. Design, create and maintain Data Migration Execution Plans in collaboration with the Service Integrator. Provide day‑to‑day oversight and direction for the execution of data migration activities in line with the Data Migration Execution Plan. Drive and support Business and Service Integrator teams through Mock Data Cycles, Full Dress Rehearsals and Production Cutover activities, ensuring timelines and data quality KPIs are met. Provide expert guidance on data cleansing, harmonisation and preparation activities to business stakeholders. Define and advise on data validation and reconciliation approaches for migrated data; review and sign‑off validation results. Identify data migration risks and issues; propose, document and track mitigation/remediation actions; escalate to Programme Management where required. Ensure data migration activities meet internal and external audit requirements; drive actions to avoid audit findings in the data migration area. Mentor and lead a team of Data Stewards and data migration resources, including troubleshooting and resolution of complex data issues. Provide expert advice to Programme and Project Management on all aspects of data migration, including dependencies, sequencing and cutover coordination. Produce clear documentation and status reporting (data quality dashboards, reconciliation reports, lessons learned). Essential Skills and Experience Significant, demonstrable SAP experience (min. 5 years) with hands‑on involvement in data migration activities. Experience across one or more of SAP S/4HANA, ECC or relevant SAP modules is expected. Proven experience designing and delivering end‑to‑end data migration strategies and execution plans on large programmes (min. 8 years in data migration / data management roles preferred). Strong technical familiarity with data migration tools and approaches (examples: SAP S/4HANA Migration Cockpit, LSMW, SAP Data Services/BODS, Informatica, Talend, Winshuttle or equivalent) and with ETLR patterns. Strong troubleshooting skills — able to diagnose, root‑cause and resolve data load and transformation failures. Hands‑on experience with data mapping, data profiling, cleansing, reconciliation and validation techniques. Solid SQL skills and experience reading/creating transformation logic; exposure to ABAP for data loads or conversions is advantageous. Proven experience working with Service Integrators and multi‑vendor delivery models. Experience of preparing for and supporting audits related to data migration (internal audit, external auditors, SOX compliance) is highly desirable. Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills — capable of advising senior programme leads and working with business SMEs. Desirable Skills SAP certification(s) in relevant modules or data management. Prior experience in a Programme Management Office (PMO) environment or working closely with Programme Managers on cutover planning. Experience with data governance, Master Data Management (MDM) practices and data quality tooling. Experience in Agile delivery environments and in hybrid project delivery models. Qualifications Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Management, Business Administration or a related discipline; or equivalent professional experience. Relevant SAP or data management certifications are highly advantageous. Personal Attributes Strong leadership and mentoring capability; comfortable directing multiple teams and contractors. Analytical thinker with strong attention to detail. Proactive, pragmatic and resilient under pressure — able to operate effectively in high‑stake cutover periods. Collaborative and influencing style; able to work across business, technical and vendor teams. Key deliverables Approved Data Migration Strategy and ETLR design. Complete and versioned Data Migration Execution Plans. Successful completion of Mock Cycles and Full Dress Rehearsal with data quality KPIs met. Clean production cutover with agreed reconciliation outcomes and no critical audit findings arising from data migration. Data quality dashboard and reconciliations demonstrating acceptable KPIs for migrated data.
